name: Shader semantic test normalization

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Make the existing `transformed_quad_uses_analytic_coverage` test insensitive to WGSL indentation and line wrapping by normalizing whitespace before checking the `unrounded && axis_aligned` fast-path guard. This restores a reliable semantic validation gate without changing shaders or renderer behavior.
measurementPlanMarkdown: At the checkpoint, run the single failing gpui_wgpu test and record its exact failure. Change only that test assertion in `crates/gpux/crates/gpui_wgpu/src/wgpu_renderer.rs`, then rerun the focused test, the full gpui_wgpu suite with diagnostics, package formatting, check, and warning-denied Clippy. No browser benchmark is required because production/WGSL code is unchanged; the performance purpose is to unblock trustworthy broad validation for subsequent gpux experiments.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: The focused checkpoint test fails on literal indentation, while the candidate passes after whitespace normalization and continues to prove the same `unrounded && axis_aligned` guard exists. All 52 gpui_wgpu tests should pass with zero production-source or runtime behavior change.
